title: mcp_server.py: interactive orchestrator session blocked by agent capability token guard
source: Triage run wf_58b99884-2a5 (2026-07-28) — corrected re-file of PROM-155, which was reject-invalid for empty target_files
description: update_ticket_status and close_ticket are decorated with @_require_agent_token (mcp_server.py:158, 654) while create_ticket is unguarded (:592). verify_agent_token (security_utils.py:646) has no exemption for the interactive Rick/orchestrator session, so Rick's own MCP calls fail with 'unauthorized: missing or invalid agent capability token'. Fix must add an orchestrator exemption WITHOUT reopening the role-spoofing hole the HMAC guard was added to close (e.g. explicit orchestrator token issued at session start, not a blanket empty-token bypass).
proposed_changes: Issue an orchestrator-scoped capability token when mcp_server starts (or when the interactive session registers), teach verify_agent_token to accept it for rick-role calls, keep worker-Morty token requirements unchanged. Add a regression test that a spoofed role without token is still rejected. Security-sensitive: needs careful review, do not blanket-exempt empty tokens.
